senses.gloss: m. (Arab. mawz) the fruit of the wild Strawberry-tree or Arbutus (v. Löw Pfl. p. 334; Sm. Ant. s. v. Arbutum).—מי מ׳ the juice of the wild Strawberry, used for adulterating honey.
